notes_for_editor: Only a map record (OpenStreetMap), its Mapcarta copy, and the Forest Lookouts Kentucky index name this tower. Two search rounds and the cached NHLR and FFLOS Kentucky lists turned up no build, builder, staffing, fire or fate source, and the NHLR and FFLOS lists do not include it. The anyplaceamerica topo page returned 403 and was not read. The status 'standing' in data/sources/osm.json is inferred from the OSM point, so the story claims no status. The story is short because the evidence is thin. The county is backed by Mapcarta's location line (Hart, Kentucky) and by the Forest Lookouts index.
